infernals.45.en: About 45 days after start: Concerning Trends (the Red Giant Expansion situation begins)

opening.evidence: on_game_start_country fires infernals.10 (events/infernals_1_events.txt:5-143: sets d_red_giant_unstable on the home star, adds mineral/alloy deposits to the inner planets, fires infernals.45 after 45 days). 45 (:750-875) starts situation_red_giant_expansion and the Red Giant event chain. Hidden infernals.9000-9002 (events/origin_events_infernal.txt:5-81) are the supernova visuals fired by 50.

label.en: The two outcomes of the situation

note.zh: 进度满1500 → 50“恒星新星”（坏结局）；进度降到0（失败）→ 60“恢复常态”（成功缓解）；二者12个月后都引向2160。
note.en: Progress reaching 1500 -> 50 Stellar Nova (the bad ending); progress falling to 0 -> 60 Return to Normal (the star is deflated); both lead to 2160 twelve months later (common/situations/13_infernal_situations.txt:148-165).

note.zh: 进度300/600/900/1200/1500分五个阶段；阶段2→65（选择项目：保护母星或热能利用）、阶段3→70、阶段4→75、阶段5→隐藏80。
note.en: Five stages at 300 / 600 / 900 / 1200 / 1500 progress: stage 2 -> 65 (choose Protect the Homeworld or Thermal Exploitation), stage 3 -> 70, stage 4 -> 75, stage 5 -> hidden 80 (common/situations/13_infernal_situations.txt:15-146).
The situation completes: the star explodes.
The situation fails: the star is deflated.

note.zh: 与露丝矿工达成稳定，12个月后2160。
note.en: Stability reached with the lusus miners; 2160 follows 12 months later.

notes.zh: 项目“三角定位亚空间干扰源”共完成三次，依变量 red_giant_triangulation_progress 依次出现 105（第一次）、110（第二次）、115（第三次，完成）。
notes.en: The Triangulate Subspace Interference project completes three times: 105 (first), 110 (second), 115 (third, complete) by the variable red_giant_triangulation_progress (hidden 100, events/infernals_1_events.txt:1800-1915).

notes.zh: “恒星隧道”：当调查进度≥8时由月度检查（隐藏85）以40%或60%概率触发，启用“三角定位亚空间干扰源”项目。
notes.en: Stellar Tunneling: when investigation progress is 8 or more the monthly check (hidden 85) rolls 40% or 60% to fire it, enabling the Triangulation project (events/infernals_1_events.txt:1574-1800).

notes.zh: 应对方针取决于阶段所设旗标（approach1–4）；“不惜一切代价”仅在阶段4–5可选。
notes.en: The available approaches depend on stage flags (approach1-4); At Any Cost is only available in stages 4-5 (common/situations/13_infernal_situations.txt:171-429).

uncertain: The options of the 2115 Boarding Party and 2125 Alien Negotiations windows lead to the same few follow-ups (2130 / 2131 / 2135) and were taken from the compiled tree.
The range infernals.45-160 and 2105-2160 was added to content/origin-families.json; infernals.56 (Lava Whirlpool anomaly) is excluded as generic.
